metadata.title: Data Loss Prevention

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for preventing unauthorized transmission, exposure, or exfiltration of institutional data.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Data loss prevention systems, content inspection engines, policy enforcement points, and monitoring services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern enforcing controls that prevent data from leaving approved boundaries or contexts.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: DLP applies to data whose ownership, authority, and baseline trust are defined under Data Core.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Data classification determines which data is subject to loss prevention controls.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Permitted handling and sharing rules inform what constitutes unauthorized data egress.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: DLP aligns with NIST SP 800-53 controls governing monitoring, boundary protection, and auditability.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: DLP is a core preventive control within continuous monitoring strategies.

metadata.remarks: Data Loss Prevention defines enforceable controls that detect, prevent, and respond to unauthorized data transmission or disclosure. This pattern enforces containment of data according to established classification and handling rules and does not define data sensitivity, consent, or retention.

components.title: Unauthorized Data Egress Control
components.description: Detects and blocks unauthorized attempts to transmit data outside approved systems, destinations, or recipients.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of data over legitimate or trusted channels.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Egress filtering and content inspection prevent unauthorized transmission.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection mechanisms restrict unauthorized data flows.

components.title: Data Content Inspection
components.description: Identifies sensitive or restricted data through inspection and classification-aware detection mechanisms.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of data through channels with insufficient inspection.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Content inspection and labeling detect sensitive data in motion.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Systems monitor data flows to detect inappropriate disclosure.

components.title: Channel-Aware Enforcement
components.description: Applies loss prevention controls appropriate to the transmission channel, destination, and risk context.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid credentials to extract or transmit data through alternative or unexpected channels.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Context- and channel-aware policy enforcement limits misuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information flow enforcement reflects permitted channels and contexts.

components.title: Data Loss Event Observability
components.description: Provides detection, alerting, and auditability for attempted or successful data loss events.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or deletion of evidence related to data exfiltration or leakage.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Logging, alerting, and review support detection and response.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data loss events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports investigation and containment.
